description.value: Menbow Ramen Bar is an authentic Japanese ramen restaurant in downtown Victoria that imports key ingredients directly from Japan and features Japanese-trained chefs. It is one of the few ramen spots on Vancouver Island to offer both a creamy tonkotsu (pork bone) broth and a clear tori (chicken) broth across a wide range of flavour profiles. Touring cyclists can dine in or order for pick-up via the website or third-party delivery apps.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 42m; rack at 58m; floor (covered) at 69m; rack at 74m; rack at 87m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Menbow is an active, multi-location Japanese ramen restaurant; the downtown Victoria location at 1018 Blanshard St with phone 250.477.3883 aligns with the OSM coordinates. Takeout/pick-up is confirmed by the website's 'Order for Pick-Up' section, and a vegetarian option (Tomato Ramen) is explicitly named on the menu. No evidence of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere on the site.
